title: Board Unified Selection And Background Clear
description: Single selection set for nodes, edges, and handles; background click deselects; area marquee includes handles; BoardEngine extend pick.
summary: BoardHost: background pointer-up without drag clears selection (screen distance < 4px); rectangle/lasso area selection adds handles when target is nodes&edges only; pointer_up uses start_screen vs end_screen for click detection. BoardEngine: pointer_down(x,y,extend_selection) merges mixed kinds when extend is true. Vitest: background click clears, marquee includes handles. Rust host/engine tests added. React test: stable onReady + syncBoardScene after second render so imperative scene matches JSX (nested host vs act timing). WASM rebuilt.
